name: Nike
source: A shy, gentle, and compassionate boy. He dislikes fighting and has little talent for it, so he is perceived as an underachiever and is perpetually stationed at the medical unit in Nirvana. However, this doesn't seem to bother him. He goes into the forest to pick medicinal herbs almost daily.
